A '''species''' that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. This bipedal [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was distinguished by the row of [[Bone/Legends|horns]] that extended from their forehead up and over the top of their craniums.<ref name="Legacy" /> By [[138 ABY]],<ref name="Extremes TPB">''[[Star Wars: Legacy Volume 10: Extremes]]''</ref> [[Unidentified horn-row Sith Lord|a member]] of this species served as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] among the [[One Sith]] and [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], defeated and left to die that year on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]] after a confrontation with [[Cade Skywalker]] and his allies.<ref name="Legacy" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[2010]] comic book [[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]], written by both [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]], illustrated by the latter.<ref name="Legacy" /> Duursema had originally posted on an online message board in [[2012]] that she had intended for this [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to be a [[Human/Legends|Human]] with spike implants grafted on his skull, stating it as fact,<ref name="Answer">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?f=1&t=19441&p=260230#p260230|thread=Question for John or Jan regarding Legacy #48|user=[[Jan Duursema]]|date=2012-06-26|time=08:55|quote=That Sith was human--with a lot of tats and some spike implants on his skull.}}</ref> though this was eventually overruled when [[Leland Chee]] revealed on [[Wikipedia:Discord|Discord]] that he treats this individual as a horned [[Alien/Legends|alien]] within the [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Leland Species 1">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-12-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1445130449054728343|quote=MANITOBAN was the production codename for anything related to Black Mask. Vidara Jurness has a species name but I don't know if it was ever published. Ayo Bons does not yet have a species name though I keyword that species as "spike mohawk." There was a similar unnamed character of what I assume is that species in the old Legacy comic series. I have a Holocron entry that tries to track "horn, spike, and plate-headed species" in the hopes that I can avoid naming a species twice.|archivefile=File:LelandChee-Manitoban-Discord.png}} {{C|In response to: "Hello @HolocronKeeper, back with what feels like my now-monthly species-related question that you may be able to shed some light on. We've seen this mysterious title crop up randomly across various places, in reference specifically to members of the Black Mask. "Manitoban" has been used by Bart Mixon in at least 3 different social media posts to refer to Ayo Bons, and some weird licensed Star Wars NFT someone discovered refers to Vidara Jurness as a Manitoban as well. Is this possibly like a species name for either of them that was accidentally applied to both, or maybe the original name for the Black Mask used in production, or just something totally different? I know Manitoban can also refer to IRL Manitoba in Canada as well, but from what I can tell, neither actor here is associated with that location, so I'm honestly at a loss."}}</ref><ref name="Leland Species 2">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-12-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1445136185998446804|quote=It's a Sith with a black ponytail in Legacy Extremes.|archivefile=File:LelandChee-LegacySithPonytail-Discord.png}} {{C|In response to: "Very good to finally have an answer, thank you as always! Guess I'll start digging through Legacy to try and pinpoint exactly which individual you're referring to, and cool to know unidentified comic species from back then still have a chance of being named/resurfacing someday. I'll let you know if for some reason I can't find it, and look forward to sending you another of my niche species questions probably next year lol!"}}</ref>
